sub _parse_priority($self, $clause) {
    confess "Error: (priority ...) requires '(priority lhs over rhs)'\n"
        unless @$clause == 4
            && defined($clause->[1])
            && !ref($clause->[1])
            && length($clause->[1])
            && defined($clause->[2])
            && !ref($clause->[2])
            && $clause->[2] eq 'over'
            && defined($clause->[3])
            && !ref($clause->[3])
            && length($clause->[3]);

    return [ @{$clause}[1 .. $#$clause] ];
}
